evidence.name: list_generations
evidence.description: Report past generate_model tasks created by the calling account, newest first. When status is 'done' the entry carries a download URL for the GLB, valid for 7 days. Use this to find 3D models generated earlier when the task_id was lost.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_models, get_model, get_generation, list_generations · Public sink: generate_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_models, get_model, get_generation, list_generations · Public sink: generate_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
